table_title: Table 9.9.3.11.1: EPS attach type information element
rows: All other values are unused and shall be interpreted as "EPS attach", if received by the network.
Bit 4 of octet 1 is spare and shall be coded as zero.
"EPS RLOS attach" shall be interpreted as "EPS attach" by a network not supporting attach for access to RLOS.
